title: SynthLab
summary: SynthLab is a FastAPI/PyTorch web platform for generating and auditing synthetic tabular data, offering CTGAN and GaussianCopula synthesizers alongside a custom TableVAE, with fidelity and privacy-audit checks. It directly imports SDV's single_table module, running CTGANSynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to fit and sample synthetic datasets.
